$comment: Era base for the 2000-2011 DTM (V8 silhouettes: Abt-Audi TT-R and Audi A4, AMG-Mercedes CLK and C-Klasse, Opel Astra V8 Coupe and Vectra GTS V8, 4.0 V8 with restrictors, Dunlop control tyre). Every season in seasons/ with "base": "dtm-era3" builds on it (tools/layers.py). 2003 is the mother template: the first era-3 season built, and the year whose cars the sound overlay will be recorded from. The tracks are the era-4 traces where the layout matches; values here are first guesses, not yet simulated.
title: DTM 2000-2011 (era base)

track_overrides.$comment: Tyre wear from the 2012 pack (one dry Dunlop-like tyre, two stops per race in the simulator), as a starting point for the era's two mandatory stops. The Norisring keeps era 4's speed_mult (the Group A trace is far too slow for these cars). Not yet simulated for era 3.

audio.$comment: Engine sounds (tools/engine_audio; the audio stays out of git), shared by every season on this base. None recorded yet, so the packs keep the game's vanilla sounds. recording_years: only recordings of these years' cars are used (2003 is the mother template; later era-3 years inherit its sounds). research_season: the entry list that tells which driver drove which make in the videos. key_prefix: start of the clip keys in the game's sound manifests.
